testResults.name: operator-session-security
testResults.result: 20 tests passed for loopback sessions, workspace authorization, TLS/auth/browser controls, token redaction, injected Foundry preflight, unavailable providers/models, and preserved offline access.

testResults.name: runtime-profile-integration
testResults.result: Runtime configuration exposes local-loopback@1.0.0 and azure-managed@1.0.0, matching the workspace manifest's pinned profile contract without committed credentials.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, Ruff format, and ty checks passed with injected fakes and no real login or network call.

decisions: Non-loopback operation fails closed unless TLS, Entra identity, exact HTTPS origins, CSRF, secure HttpOnly cookies, and same-site controls are enabled.
Foundry credentials remain backend-only; capability reports never include access tokens or provider exception text.
limitations: Production composition must inject a concrete Azure Identity credential and Foundry deployment client.
